frozen.question: What do Samsung Galaxy S10 users say about screen quality and everyday performance?

chunks.text: Good phone, for a while.. I got this phone for my wife, it was the highest performance phone she had ever had. I have the S9, and have no complaints, so I got her the next model since it has been about 2.5 years since getting mine. Well, it ran really well. Did all her games, texting, facebook, video chats, websurfing, pictures, etc... really well. Until one evening she was watching a streaming movie, and when she quit watching and picked the phone up, the bottom inch or so of the screen went pure white. The screen still responded to touch, but nothing was visible within that white band. The phone started being weird about sending and recieving messages, slow performance, short battery life, heating up, and very slow charging (if it would charge at all). So, I will be returning it. I really wish it had worked out.

Worth every penny.. For the price, Excellent condition. Minor scratches on the screen but with the screen protector, you can't even tell. I think they might of tested the water resistance because the phone was a little damp when I received it(USB port). But great performance, and very fast overall. Very much of what I was expecting and more!

The screen quality is awesome as well and you can change the settings to make it over over top crystal clear or a Lil less so to save battery life. The sound is really good I used to think I had a bad aux cord in the work truck or at least the sound system was weak but now that I'm using this phone for Spotify at work it's crisp and clear I am very pleased with this purchase I'd say for the price it was more then worth it

Poor quality. The quality of the phone was a let down. The phone screen cracked in a few weeks after use due to no apparent reason. A protective screen cover and case was on. Still I noticed a screen crack one day and another one few days later.

Team Samsung Galaxy!. A natural upgrade from my galaxy s8 which served me well but had to retire due to an excessively cracked screen. Very reliable phones however, haven't had an issue with their build quality or performance yet! Keep up the good work!

Good phone. Everything is great about the phone if you're a regular Samsung user. I went from a Galaxy S7 to this S10 and have seen a noticeable difference in performance. The only thing I'm bummed about is a close-up picture setting that was on the S7 but not on the S10. Despite that, the camera is of excellent quality and has a fast response.

Nice phone. Pros: Resolution, Camera, User friendly interface, Handy & fast. Cons: Battery life, Fingerprint sensor is not working when you add a screen protector(may be due to thinkness of the protector).

Great Buy. I upgraded my phone from S7 mostly due to the depleting battery life. I do not regret my decision. For general use, a charge lasts for a whole day. The performance is a lot better as well. The downside of the phone is that is the sides of the screen. When I hold the phone, it sometimes take unnecessary actions. I had some difficulty using one hand. Overall, it is a great buy.

Worse buy ever. I loved this phone and the performance was great. But I notice some flaws from day one when I purchased it. The speaker sounded muffled, the screen had burn in when I got it and it supposed to be brand new and the charger set was generic. I wouldn't recommend this at all to anyone

Great phone dude below is probably a iPhone user. Amazing phone awesome cameras great display finger print scanner is fast once you get used to it love the phone don't listen to the guy below he has 10e and is nit picking and audio quality is fine I'm coming form a note 9
